description: This file defines a Perl package Git::SVN::Editor that implements a custom Subversion delta editor for use with git-svn. It manages diff generation, file operations, property changes, and translating git tree differences into SVN commit actions.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Editor
classes.description: A Perl module implementing a custom SVN delta editor tailored for use with git-svn to translate git tree diffs into SVN changes.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor initializing the editor with provided options, setting up diff data and context.

methods.name: generate_diff
methods.description: Generates a diff between two git trees, returning a list of modifications.

methods.name: check_diff_paths
methods.description: Checks the type of paths (file, directory, none) at given revision for diff paths.

methods.name: split_path
methods.description: Splits a path into directory and filename components.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Converts a file path to repository relative path, respecting pathname encoding.

methods.name: url_path
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a given repository path.

methods.name: rmdirs
methods.description: Removes directories in the working copy as needed based on diff modifications.

methods.name: open_or_add_dir
methods.description: Opens an existing directory or adds a new one, with safeguards based on path type.

methods.name: ensure_path
methods.description: Ensures that a directory path exists in the repository, creating intermediate directories as needed.

methods.name: glob2pat
methods.description: Converts a glob pattern to a regular expression.

methods.name: check_autoprop
methods.description: Checks auto-props configuration and applies matching properties to files.

methods.name: apply_autoprops
methods.description: Applies auto-properties to files based on their names and svn config.

methods.name: check_attr
methods.description: Checks SVN attributes for a given path.

methods.name: apply_manualprops
methods.description: Applies manually specified properties to files based on svn attributes.

methods.name: A
methods.description: Handles 'add' operation for a new file.

methods.name: C
methods.description: Handles 'copy' operation for a file.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Handles deletion of a file or directory entry.

methods.name: R
methods.description: Handles 'replace' operation for a file.

methods.name: M
methods.description: Handles 'modify' operation for a file.

methods.name: T
methods.description: Handles toggling a symlink, workaround for SVN issue.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Changes file properties.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Changes directory properties.

methods.name: _chg_file_get_blob
methods.description: Retrieves a blob of file content based on git object IDs.

methods.name: chg_file
methods.description: Changes a file's content and properties based on a diff.

methods.name: D
methods.description: Handles 'delete' operation for a file.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Closes the edit and finalizes the SVN changes.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Aborts the current edit, discarding changes.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources.

methods.name: apply_diff
methods.description: Applies the accumulated diff modifications to perform SVN updates.
